agentProfiles.name: Sol 6.1 medium
agentProfiles.notes: Workspace lead for bounded documentation/reconciliation with known contracts, or a bounded non-specialist delegated subtask/review. DOC4 six-guide correction and clean-context review motivate this shared bundle. Worker implements directly; upstream root alone is orchestration-only, so do not create a coordinator/implementation lead layer. Reviewers inspect independently without implementing fixes. Escalate to Sol high for broader contracts, code, uncertain evidence or interacting lifecycle work; medium reduces reasoning cost but is not measured cheaper/faster here. Excludes complex implementation/spatial specialist questions and Luna-style title-based routing. Use only the task-authorized tools and permissions; this bundle grants no MCP, network, editor, service, account or device access. auto-review requests workspace-write with on-request approvals; verify effective provider overrides and sandbox before work. Keep independent review in clean context. No silent model/effort fallback or ultra.

agentProfiles.name: Astra 6 high bounded spatial specialist
agentProfiles.notes: Necessary targeted visual/spatial/modeling specialist SUBAGENT only, reporting to a Sol workspace lead for synthesis. S02 camera/target placement, source-linked dimensions/sockets and inherited-scene/capture review demonstrated this role and found a target/tower overlap. Before launch specify a concrete specialist question, required artifact/findings output, exact candidate, validation boundary and proportionate task budget/stop. High matches the sampled specialist setting; begin with one focused inspection and one affected-fix follow-up, stop/report missing evidence; longer/new questions require Sol to rescope. No token/spend cap is provided by this profile schema. Use Sol for ordinary source/code/contracts. Explicitly excludes workspace leadership, implementation lead, broad planning/research/code/review/orchestration and whole map/art workstreams merely because 3D is mentioned. No human-feel, OS-focus, hardware/performance or Steam certification from captures. More expensive routing is justified only by the named specialist question; no automatic ultra or fast-mode premium.
